messages.subject: Error in creating species detection history
parts:
Hi i'm trying to create a species detection history but keep getting this error 
"Error in detectionHistory(recordTable = DFR, camOp = camop_problem, stationCol = "Station",  :
  Not all values of stationCol in recordTable are matched by rownames of camOp"

I'm not quite sure why. Hope someone can help me with this? Below are the codes i used:

#camera operation matrix
# with problems/malfunction
camop_problem <- cameraOperation(CTtable      = DFR1,
                                 stationCol   = "Station",
                                 setupCol     = "Setup",
                                 retrievalCol = "Retrieval",
                                 cameraCol    = "Camera",
                                 byCamera     = TRUE,
                                 writecsv     = FALSE,
                                 hasProblems  = TRUE,
                                 dateFormat   = "%d/%m/%Y"
)

#create detection history
DetHist2 <- detectionHistory(recordTable          = DFR,
                             camOp                = camop_problem,
                             stationCol           = "Station",
                             speciesCol           = "Species",
                             species              = "Bearded Pig",
                             recordDateTimeCol    = "DateTimeOriginal",
                             recordDateTimeFormat = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M",
                             occasionLength       = 1,
                             day1                 = "station",
                             datesAsOccasionNames = FALSE,
                             includeEffort        = TRUE,
                             scaleEffort          = FALSE,
                             timeZone             = "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur"
)

Thank you!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Error in creating species detection history
parts:
Hi,

the error message means that your record table contains stations that you don't have effort information for in your camera operation matrix (the stations are probably missing in the camera trap table).

Did you check the row names of the camera operation matrix:

rownames(camop_problem)

and the stations in the record table:

unique(DFR$Station)

I'd suggest you check for mismatches, e.g. with something like this: 

unique(DFR$Station) [!unique(DFR$Station) %in% rownames(camop_problem)]


Also, apologies for the late reply. Google again put group emails into spam.

Best regards
